title: Machi - Living biome engine for the 2D pixel world
author: jin_sprited
selftext: Working on this cellular automata using GLSL shaders to grow trees. It uses bunch of gradients like resources, noise, energy, light, etc.  Fun to iterate on it but it is rather a time sink. Should I continue?

replies.author: jin_sprited
replies.body: Thanks! That means a lot to me! Qould you be interested in a post for how it was done?

replies.author: GlitteringJob9248
replies.body: Sure I would like to play this game tbh

replies.author: jin_sprited
replies.body:
Thanks! I would love to.  The concept is to have lots of little living beings inhabit this kinda terrarium and to have connected set of these terrarium to make into a virtual world. 

I have long way to go and other projects may take priority but I will get there!

comments.author: Count_Triple
comments.body:
The branches and roots are looking really good! I like to imagine the systems needed to achieve these kinds of effects.   
I have a similar side project, more like a sand physics game. My tree leaves decay into more soil and the roots prevent the soil below them from shifting. This makes me want to spend all day on it!
